subject.title: Feature: Project trees + threaded entry points in Control UI

question: Should OpenClaw core add first-class project/thread organization to Control UI now, and what persistent session and Gateway transcript semantics should route targets, split/move, and seed-copy expose?
rationale: The missing capability is real, but the long-lived contract spans Control UI UX, Gateway protocol shape, persisted session/project metadata, and transcript mutation or copy semantics, so automation should not choose the product boundary.

options.title: Define Core Product/API First
options.body: Keep this open while maintainers specify project/thread metadata, tree UI, route-target or fanout payloads, and split/copy transcript semantics before implementation.

options.title: Narrow To Session Organization
options.body: Limit near-term work to labels, grouping, search, pinning, archiving, and session switching over existing session primitives without transcript mutation or composer fanout.

options.title: Defer Broader Workflow
options.body: Rely on current session management, reply quoting, and checkpoint branching until stronger demand or a narrower API proposal appears.

recommendation.title: Define Core Product/API First
recommendation.body: Keep this open while maintainers specify project/thread metadata, tree UI, route-target or fanout payloads, and split/copy transcript semantics before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already provided the prior routing signal and authored the adjacent session-management implementation that partially overlaps this request.
